parameters.content:
## 🏋️ GymBuddy AI — Telegram Coach
Part 1 (top): **the bot**. Members chat with it on Telegram: /link, /today, /workout, /eat, /done, /log, /report, or any free question.

Part 2 (bottom): **3 schedules** push messages without being asked: 07:30 morning brief, 20:30 streak nudge, Sunday 19:00 weekly recap.

Data: the live GymBuddy API (profile, targets, workouts, restaurants, chatbot) + 3 tabs in the CRM Google Sheet (`TG_Subscribers`, `TG_Workouts`, `TG_Meals`).

Built on ideas from the n8n community templates #7756 (meal logger + progress bars, by John Alejandro Silva) and #16969 (Telegram fitness coach with Sheets logging, by Dr. Firas). See automation/TELEGRAM_COACH.md.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.LLM_MODEL || 'openrouter/free', temperature: 0.6, max_tokens: Number($env.LLM_MAX_TOKENS || 1500), messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are GymBuddy, an upbeat but precise gym coach writing a Telegram message. Using the member JSON, write max 120 words: 1) today's session focus with 2-3 key exercises and one technique cue (respect equipment and injuries), 2) one simple meal idea that fits the calorie/protein targets and respects diet and allergies, 3) one short motivational line that mentions the streak if it is above 0. Use short lines and emojis, no tables, no markdown headings. Answer in the member's language (en or fr)." }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify({ ...$json.member, streak: $json.streak, weekday: $now.toFormat('cccc') }) } ] }) }}

parameters.content:
### 💬 Bot commands
One Switch routes every Telegram message. Commands that need the member's plan are sent to *Ask To Link* until the member runs `/link email` (checked against the app's opted-in members). Free text goes to the app's own RAG chatbot (`/api/chat`); if the app can't answer, the AI model answers directly.

### ⏰ Scheduled coaching
Morning brief (AI, 1 request per member), evening nudge (no AI, only members who planned to train and haven't sent /done), Sunday recap (AI, uses the logged workouts and meals).

Write a Telegram good-morning message (max 90 words) for this member: greet by first name, today's session focus with one key exercise and cue (or a recovery idea on rest days), the calorie/protein/water targets in one line, one breakfast idea that respects diet and allergies, and a punchy closing line (mention the streak if above 0). Emojis welcome, no headings. Answer in the member's language." }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify({ ...$json.member, streak: $json.streak, weekday: $now.toFormat('cccc') }) } ] }) }}
